policy: Append-only recorded execution/artifact evidence. Entries are recorded by an execution harness or a verified gate run (never by hand-editing a projection): each entry names the operation, the kind (runtime_execution | artifact_evidence | production_like), the method that produced the evidence, the recording time, and the source revision it was observed at. The truth engine CONSUMES this file and never rewrites it; absence of an entry is honest absence of proof, not a defect to hide.
recorded_by: python -m nexus_ai_agent.nagar --check (verification only; does not append)
CI execution harnesses that run a real operation and verify its artifact
